name: Energy Storage Systems for EVs
description: Classification of energy storage systems, role of energy storage in EV, performance metrics, fundamentals of electrochemical energy storage, Li-ion batteries and emerging battery technologies, battery pack design, battery management systems, overview of battery models, charging infrastructure, different types of chargers, charging standards, fast charging, battery thermal management, battery pack safety and associated standards, battery pack lifecycle conditions, battery repurposing and recycling, vehicle to grid, future of electric mobility, case studies from industry.
